title: Boreal
body:
Boreal is a special tree only obtainable in snowy peaks, Snowlands and in between. It takes the appearance of a translucent Willow tree, but with pink leaves and turquoise wood with an aurora inside and surrounding it.

It is obtainable by first waiting for an Aurora event in the server, then needing the Auroracrest Axe to chop it down. It is one of, if not the hardest to obtain trees as it only spawns in a specific location, during a specific event, requires an expensive tool, and has no meteors containing it.

This tree cannot be obtained with leaves, due to Auroracrest Axe not saving leaves on trees, and The Living Axe being incapable of cutting Boreal.
